procedure.method: Read and SHA-256/byte-checked only the explicitly pinned inputs using Python 3. Packet source_assets and protected_layouts are both empty, so neither supplied source viewing nor protected-layout reading was applicable. Visually inspected six images through six separate tools.view_image calls with detail original, emitting each returned image at original detail: M1 native, M1 usage720, M1 thumbnail320, then M2 native, M2 usage720, M2 thumbnail320. All six successful visual inspections preceded the first transcription judgment, every image score and the diversity score. Verified PNG IHDR dimensions against the packet after viewing. No image edits, additional view/crop, ambiguity revisit, peer review, embedded unpinned path, spawned agent or runtime session-ID claim was used. Runner provenance is left to the runner.

typography.observation: The URL dot, slash and hyphen are intact; the material slash is clearly separate from the words. The bottom horizontal caption is distinct from lettering on the tilted sheet.
The required copy remains readable at this use size, with no overlap by the lever or finger.

typography.location: upper sheet and bottom-right material line
typography.observation: Title and slogan remain the clearest text; the thinner supporting lines are considerably smaller. They preserve their line structure but do not have headline-level readability.

space.location: upper printed sheet, diagonal lower edge and dark clip below
space.observation: The tilted sheet supplies a common alignment for the title, slogan, description, URL and instruction. Its lower edge guides the eye into the open jaws, while the body uses the lower half of the portrait.

space.location: bottom material caption and lower mounting strip
space.observation: The material caption has clear separation from the product and bottom edge. The empty upper-right gray region balances the sheet instead of crowding the hand.

image_material.location: right fingertip and black short lever above the silver hub
image_material.observation: Nail translucency, skin creases, matte metal grain and stepped radial metal highlights are convincingly differentiated. Finger contact does not cover the pivot or the open throat.

image_material.location: two left-facing pads and lower edge of white sheet
image_material.observation: Both dark pad surfaces and the single sheet edge can be distinguished in the open mouth. The thick desk edge has a rounded profile and a contact shadow beneath the mounting body.

The folded mounting strip and open jaws remain coherent. The changed viewing side makes the hub relief and pad outline harder to match exactly to M1, a continuity limitation rather than evidence of an additional component.

emotion_control.location: printed white memo sheet and black product against pale gray desk
emotion_control.observation: The printed sheet creates a controlled, specific demonstration context. Neutral lighting and restrained color retain the requested real-product-photo mood.
The large paper/clip contrast communicates useful, deliberate operation; the text and tactile close-up do not compete through unrelated decoration.

ai_slop.location: silver hub, black folded body, upper/lower pads and pressing hand crop
ai_slop.observation: The visible component count is coherent: one hub, two facing pads, one cropped hand. There are no extra fingers or unrelated pieces floating into the gap.

ai_slop.location: lettering on white sheet and lower-right caption
ai_slop.observation: Copy is complete without garbled repetitions, invented branding or ornamental filler. The sheet is a content-bearing part of the scene, not a generic texture backdrop.

residuals: The introduction/URL appears above the action sentence, so the secondary reading sequence detours through the link before returning to the demonstration.
The tall printed sheet creates a strong title block, but its small supporting copy and the bottom material caption need close viewing at thumbnail size.

The raised hub profile and squarer projected lower pad look different from the landscape view. The changed side and oblique projection limit exact detail comparison; no additional component or definite contradictory mechanism is visible.

evidence.observation: The near side-on clip spans a wide middle band, pressure enters from the left and the sheet enters from the right. Overlay copy is split between the upper header and lower desk/paper regions, unlike M2's tall printed-sheet arrangement.

The oblique opposite-side presentation puts pressure on the right and the jaws/sheet on the left. Most copy sits on one tall angled sheet above a lower-half product, giving a real change in composition and reading path rather than a palette substitution.

residuals: The pair stays in the same neutral photographic register and repeats the same operation moment. Diversity comes from viewpoint, image placement and the treatment of the sheet; it is strong rather than exceptionally broad.

Both preserve the same visible component scheme. The opposite-side views show different hub relief and projected pad outlines, so fine machining continuity is less directly comparable than the common clip silhouette.
